description: Latest official euro foreign exchange reference rate (European Central Bank, published each TARGET working day ~16:00 CET) for 29 currencies, with daily change and up to 90 days of history. Use for 'EUR to USD today' or to convert between two listed currencies via the euro.

base.description: Optional second currency: returns the cross rate base->currency (via EUR). Default EUR.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, JPY, CZK. Omit to get all currencies.

history.description: Include the last 90 days (only with currency).

name: fx_rate
